metadata.title: LoopX historical MIT license

applicability.scope: Preparing acceptance criteria, documenting or reviewing an optimization campaign whose verdict will be cited downstream
applicability.prerequisites: For preparation, the user requirements and available model/hardware/workload evidence; for verdicts, pinned baseline and candidate SHAs and an evidence tree under evidence/<campaign-id>/; conclusions about LoopX goal authority additionally need its governance reference
applicability.input_contract: Campaign artifacts in plan/, results/, patch/ and validator/, plus the RunSpec that fixes repo x revision x backend x device x model x scenario
applicability.produced_artifact: An evidence record that links paths instead of pasting metrics, and states exactly one of PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with its rationale
failure_modes: Metrics pasted into an issue comment with no link to an evidence path
PASS recorded on a cleanup or integrity-probe failure
Output reused across trials, aliased into a reference, or written outside its own trial directory
Source fingerprint taken over a directory overlap that excludes changed tracked files
Org-wide default SHAs assumed in a skill or CI instead of read from the acceptance issue
applicability.refusal_point: Refuses PASS when the validator freeze, the results rationale or the pinned SHAs are missing, and reports INCONCLUSIVE for that campaign instead

limitations: Documents evidence discipline; it performs no measurement and certifies no campaign.
The LoopX goal-governance reference is a source-derived candidate and adds no execution permission or empirical validation.
Checkout-only local skill; no automatic execution or promotion.
Only declared references are required; other cross-skill links are navigation.
Historical revisions require a matching checkout or a retained store.
Original-byte identity authenticates file contents, not full-file semantic review; inspected_scope states the actual readset.
Python source preparation and TypeScript decisions/accounting remain distinct; no pure Python quota kernel is extracted.
Local accounting idempotency and repair do not establish external exactly-once execution or supplier hard cost ceilings.
This candidate does not implement InferRSI goal checkpoints or promote the inherited owner.
